blocks.text: INQUIRER.net / Updated as of: 08:52 AM November 02, 2026

MANILA, Philippines — As the long Undas weekend draws to a close, Filipinos who traveled to their home provinces to observe All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day are expected to begin their journey back to Metro Manila and other urban centers on Monday. Bus terminals, seaports and airports are bracing for an influx of passengers as travelers return home ahead of the resumption of work and classes.
Follow this live coverage for Undas updates from Inquirer reporters on the ground and the latest developments affecting travelers nationwide. /dp
